title: AI 營運成效怎麼看：一張 Dashboard 回答「AI 值不值得」
summary: 整理 AI 營運成效 Dashboard 的指標框架：採用、品質、效益、成本、風險五個面向，以及對內 Copilot、Gemini 與對外 AI Agent 各自的資料來源。
title_en: How to read AI operations performance: one dashboard that answers "is AI worth it?"
summary_en: The metric framework for an AI operations dashboard: adoption, quality, value, cost, and risk, and where the data comes from for internal tools such as Copilot and Gemini and for external AI Agents.

title: 銀行的 AI 安全護欄怎麼做：從金管會原則到 3,600 題實測
summary: 整理我在銀行跟進金控 AI 安全護欄 PoC 時建立的框架：AI 治理三層、護欄四層防禦、政策順序、題庫設計、漏放率與誤擋率，以及護欄與紅隊驗證的分工。
title_en: How a bank builds AI guardrails: from FSC principles to a 3,600-case test
summary_en: The framework I built while following the holding company's AI guardrails PoC: three layers of AI governance, four guardrail layers, policy order, test-set design, miss rate versus false blocks, and how guardrails and red-team validation split the work.

title: 用 RAG 打造金融智能客服的踩坑紀錄
summary: 分享在 TEJ 實習期間，從零建構 RAG 智能客服系統的經驗，包括 Qdrant 向量資料庫的選型、chunk 策略的調整，以及如何讓 LLM 回答得更精準。
title_en: Lessons from building a RAG customer service bot for finance
summary_en: How I built a RAG customer service system at TEJ: choosing Qdrant, tuning the chunking strategy, and making LLM answers more accurate.

title: Multi-Agent 投資決策架構：讓 AI 像基金團隊一樣思考
summary: 如何用 LangGraph 建構多個 AI Agent 分別負責技術分析、新聞情緒、基本面研究，再透過辯論機制整合出投資訊號。
title_en: A Multi-Agent investment architecture: AI that thinks like a fund team
summary_en: How I used LangGraph to build Agents for technicals, news sentiment, and fundamentals, then combined them into a signal through debate.
